description.zh:
要操作的原生防护实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~)查询所有原生防护实例的ID信息。
description.en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

> Call [DescribeInstanceList](~~118698~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Origin instances.

description.zh:
要从原生防护实例的防护对象中移除的IP地址列表。使用JSON数组转化的字符串格式表示。JSON数组中的每个元素是一个结构体，包含以下字段：

- **ip**：String类型 | 必选 | 要移除的IP地址。
    
    > IP地址必须已经在原生防护实例的防护列表。
description.en:
A list of IP addresses to remove from the protected objects of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance. Specify the list as a string that is a JSON array. Each element in the array is a struct that contains the following field:

- **ip**: The IP address to remove. This parameter is a string and is required.

  > The IP address must be in the protection list of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

description.zh:
原生防护实例的地域ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~118703~~)查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域信息。
description.en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

> Call [DescribeRegions](~~118703~~) to query all regions that Anti-DDoS Origin supports.

description.zh:
原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见[创建资源组](~~94485~~)。
description.en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. If you leave this parameter empty, the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see [Create a resource group](~~94485~~).

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ddosbgp delete-ip --ip-list ip_:_1.XX.XX.1_,_ip_:_2.XX.XX.2 --instance-id ddosbgp-cn-npk1z7t90000 --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
